name: Maple Family Dental
directions: Park in the lot behind the building; the entrance is on 12th Street. We're upstairs in Suite 2B, and the elevator is just left of the lobby doors.

appointmentTypes.name: Cleaning
appointmentTypes.prep: Brush and floss like you normally would. If your doctor has you pre-medicate before dental work, take it an hour before.

appointmentTypes.name: Perio maintenance
appointmentTypes.prep: Your gums may be a little tender afterward, so plan on soft food tonight. If you pre-medicate, take it an hour before.

appointmentTypes.name: New patient exam
appointmentTypes.prep: Bring your insurance card and a list of your medications. Come 10 minutes early for paperwork, or fill it out from the link we text you.

appointmentTypes.name: Filling
appointmentTypes.prep: Eat before you come in. You'll likely be numb for a couple of hours afterward.

appointmentTypes.name: Crown prep
appointmentTypes.prep: Plan on about 90 minutes. You'll leave with a temporary crown, so skip sticky foods until the permanent one goes in.

appointmentTypes.name: Root canal
appointmentTypes.prep: If you can, take ibuprofen an hour before and have a light meal. You'll be numb for a few hours.

appointmentTypes.name: Limited exam
appointmentTypes.prep: Tell us exactly where it hurts and since when. It helps us get you sorted fast.

appointmentTypes.name: Crown seat
appointmentTypes.prep: Quick visit to put your permanent crown in.

appointmentTypes.name: Implant consult
appointmentTypes.prep: Bring any recent x-rays from other offices.
